instructions.name: execute_swap
docs: Spend a `mint_in` note, swap it through an allowlisted DEX program and shield the
proceeds as a `mint_out` note. See swap.rs.

accounts.name: swap_authority
docs: holds the unwrapped lamports of a SOL output.

accounts.name: token_program_in
docs: Each leg's own token program (SPL Token or Token-2022; SPL Token for wSOL).

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup by the program's upgrade authority: config, the SOL pool, and the
native SOL asset (always a quote) with its first tree.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Only the upgrade authority may initialize, so nobody can front-run the deployment.

instructions.name: register_asset
docs: Permissionless mode only: anyone may register a token's tree so it can be bought.

accounts.name: tree
docs: The epoch-0 tree; only created on first registration.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The asset's pool, global_config's ATA: created here so swaps can always land in it.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The mint's own token program (SPL Token or Token-2022).

instructions.name: rotate_tree
docs: Open the asset's next epoch. Anyone may call it once the live tree is full; the
admin may call it at any time (EVM `forceRotate`).

instructions.name: set_quote_asset
docs: Add or remove an SPL quote asset (registers its tree when added).

accounts.name: tree
docs: The epoch-0 tree; only created on first registration.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The asset's pool, global_config's ATA: created here so swaps can always land in it.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The mint's own token program (SPL Token or Token-2022).

instructions.name: set_swap_allowed
docs: One-way: allow an SPL token to be bought by swap (registers its tree).

accounts.name: tree
docs: The epoch-0 tree; only created on first registration.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The asset's pool, global_config's ATA: created here so swaps can always land in it.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The mint's own token program (SPL Token or Token-2022).

instructions.name: transact
docs: Deposit, withdraw or internal transfer of native SOL.

accounts.name: spend_tree
docs: The tree the spent notes live in. May be the live tree itself.

instructions.name: transact_spl
docs: Deposit, withdraw or internal transfer of an SPL token.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Not the wSOL mint: SOL notes are backed by sol_pool only (see `transact`); a second,
wSOL-backed pool for the same notes would let one drain the other (audit finding).

accounts.name: pool
docs: The pool: global_config's ATA for the mint.

accounts.name: signer_token_account
docs: Deposit source, owned by the signer. Only needed for a deposit.

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: Withdrawal destination, bound by extDataHash. The relayer creates it beforehand if
needed, so rent griefing stays on the relayer's side.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The mint's own token program (SPL Token or Token-2022).

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Not authorized to perform this action

errors.name: UnknownRoot
errors.msg: Root is not known in the tree

errors.name: MerkleTreeFull
errors.msg: Merkle tree is full: cannot add more leaves

errors.name: RotateTreeFirst
errors.msg: The live tree is full: call rotate_tree first

errors.name: TreeNotFull
errors.msg: The live tree still has room

errors.name: NotQuoteAsset
errors.msg: Only quote assets may be deposited, withdrawn or pay fees

errors.name: NativeAsset
errors.msg: Native SOL is always a quote and always swappable

errors.name: NoQuoteLeg
errors.msg: One leg of a swap must be a quote asset

errors.name: FeeRecipientUnset
errors.msg: Set a fee recipient before charging a fee

errors.name: UnexpectedAccount
errors.msg: Account does not match the expected address

errors.name: SwapInputNotConsumed
errors.msg: Swap did not consume the exact input amount

errors.name: UnsupportedMint
errors.msg: Unsupported mint: Token-2022 extensions other than metadata are refused

errors.name: RelayerFeeWrongLeg
errors.msg: Relayer fee must be paid on the quote leg

types.name: Asset
docs: One per registered mint. Native SOL is the wSOL mint's entry and is always a quote.

fields.name: quote
docs: Quotes are the only assets that may be deposited or withdrawn, and every fee is
paid in one.

fields.name: swap_allowed
docs: One-way: once true a token stays buyable, because selling into a quote is the only
exit its notes have.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The live epoch: outputs are always written to `merkle_tree[mint, epoch]`.

fields.name: fee
docs: Relayer fee, in the spent asset.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer: set by `transfer_admin`, consumed by `claim_admin`.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Where protocol fees go: a wallet. SOL fees land on it directly, SPL fees on its ATA.
`Pubkey::default()` means unset, and then no protocol fee is charged.

fields.name: permissionless_swaps
docs: Any token may be bought, not only allowlisted ones.

types.name: NewCommitment
docs: A new leaf. `index` is global: epoch = index / TREE_CAPACITY, local = index % TREE_CAPACITY.

types.name: SolEscrowFunded
docs: A SOL-input swap moved `amount` lamports from the SOL pool into the wSOL escrow.

types.name: SolPool
docs: Holds native SOL. Program-owned, so withdrawals move its lamports directly.

types.name: SpendProof
docs: What a client sends: the Groth16 proof with its points COMPRESSED (alt_bn128 format:
big-endian x, the "y is negative" flag in the top bit of the first byte), and only the
public inputs the program cannot derive. `public_amount` and `ext_data_hash` are computed
on-chain from the instruction's own data. Together that keeps 192 bytes out of every
transaction, which a swap with a real route needs. All values big-endian.

fields.name: amount_out
docs: Net amount in the output note.

fields.name: min_out
docs: Floor on the NET amount that lands in the output note, after every fee.

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix timestamp after which the swap is refused.

fields.name: relayer_fee_out
docs: Relayer fee in mint_out, taken from the proceeds. Only when mint_in is not a quote.

fields.name: out_pubkey
docs: Output note owner. Must be a one-time key (DESIGN.md §2): it is public here.

fields.name: route_data
docs: Raw instruction data for `swap_program`; its accounts are the remaining accounts.

types.name: SwapProgramEntry
docs: Allowlist entry for a DEX program `execute_swap` may call. Two-step like EVM routers
(propose, then enable; the timelock is 0 there too), and disabling is immediate.
